[ABYM2GP5]: 22.  According to Śākya mchog ldan, rNgog Lo (ID:3786)'s Madhyamaka lineage went from rNgog Blo ldan shes rab to Gro lung pa (ID:3806) and rGya dmar ba (ID:3834), and from these two to Phya pa (ID:3831). According to Sangs rgyas phun tshogs's Ngor chos 'byung, rNgog Lo (ID:3786)'s Madhyamaka lineage went from rNgog Blo ldan shes rab to Gangs pa she'u (ID:3810) and Khyung rin chen grags (ID:3809), from these two to sTod lung rGya dmar ba Byang chub grags (ID:3834), and from him to Phya pa (ID:3831).
[Z5FZQCNC]: 143-144. Lineage of the reading transmission (lung) of the Pramāṇavārttika (ID:3772) as received by Bu ston (ID:5999): from rNgog lo tsA ba (ID:3786) to Khyung Rin chen grags (ID:3809), rGya dmar Byang chub grags (ID:3834), Phywa ba (ID:3831), gTsang nag pa (ID:3839), Dar ma bkra shis (ID:6217), gNyal pa (i.e., gNyal zhig ‘Jam pa’i rdo rje (ID:3887)), Bo dong pa (probably (ID:3904)), lDong pa Grags pa dpal (ID:7761), Lho pa Grub seng (ID:7651), Tshad ma'i skyes bu (ID:6925), Bu ston (ID:5999).
